title: Inventory kit durability, CAS, receipt, campaign-history, and recovery surfaces

acceptance.criterion: Inventory identifies exact immutable-block, idempotency, CAS, corruption, recovery, history, and proof-store contracts that the AAE domain layer must reuse.

immutable_block.authority_rule: Local blocks/ tree is authoritative; SQLite is a rebuildable acceleration index; artifact blocks are retained forever.

cas.expectation_model: expected_revision/generation plus expected_root_cid/head_cid; ABA-safe; never silent overwrite

fail_closed_rules: local CID mismatch fails recovery and refuses mutation
corrupt SQLite preserved as coordination.sqlite3.corrupt-<ms> and rebuilt from blocks
tampered root index refused after chain verification against immutable blocks
ambiguous successors rejected without picking a winner
raw transition evidence rejected before rebuild mutates indexes
semantic facade rejects raw CIDs for policy/history/root heads

proof_store.role: Optional exact-byte CID transport for proof-backed test certificates; never decides reuse or seal authority

aae_domain_layer_missing.description: Thin typed AAE persistence over DurableCoordinationStore for immutable mutant/campaign artifacts, campaign state and receipts, append-only campaign histories, Merkle/seal manifests, assurance-policy revision CAS, promotion CAS, idempotent replay, and crash recovery. Must compose existing kit primitives and governor-store patterns; must not invent a second object store, WAL, CID system, receipt hierarchy, or proof/ZK engine.

required_operations: put / put_verified for immutable mutant, campaign, gap, benchmark, and receipt payloads with caller-supplied expected CIDs
compare_and_swap_state_root / compare_and_swap_root for campaign heads, policy revisions, and promotion with expected revision/generation, expected root CID, and operation_id
recover / recover_roots for fail-closed index reconstruction
root_transitions / history linkage for append-only campaign history

repository.name: endomorphosis/ipfs_kit_py
repository.observed_subject: SCG-020: Implement append-only audit, calibration, and benchmark histories
repository.planning_note: ADVERSARIAL_ASSURANCE_ENGINE_PLAN section 2 pins kit c7e5feeb... (durable roots and governor store present). Inventory confirms the nested gitlink equals that pin.

conflict_policy.rule: Inventory reusable kit durability/CAS/receipt/history/recovery/proof-transport only. Do not invent adversarial_assurance_store APIs, a second store/WAL/CID/receipt hierarchy, or a local proof-sealer. Missing AAE domain and sealer surfaces are typed_unavailable.
conflict_policy.identity: Callers supply verified CIDs; kit verifies and does not mint replacement semantic identity. ipfs_datasets_py owns semantic content identity authority.
conflict_policy.receipts: Bind neutral receipt payloads to existing envelope machinery; do not create semantic-governor/receipt* or aae/receipt* hierarchies.
conflict_policy.proof_transport: IpfsKitProofCertificateStore moves exact certificate bytes by CID only; it never authorizes test reuse or seal publication.
conflict_policy.governor_patterns: semantic_governor_store is the reusable thin-typed pattern over DurableCoordinationStore; AAE domain package remains adversarial_assurance_store and must not rename itself into governor namespaces without a closed AAE namespace grammar.

non_goals: No second object store, WAL, or journal engine
No new CID or content-identity implementation
No new receipt envelope hierarchy or cryptography
No new daemon or network service
No AAE campaign domain schemas in this inventory (owned by datasets contracts and later AAE-034+)
No IncrementalProofSealer or seal publication APIs (typed_unavailable; AAE-004 / release-gated)
No reimplementation of Profile G codecs beyond consumption of existing kit/MCP++ authority

ownership.plan_ownership_claim: Kit owns thin typed persistence over existing durable primitives: immutable mutant artifacts, campaign state, execution receipts, assurance gaps, benchmark artifacts, campaign Merkle roots, policy revisions, CAS promotion state, idempotent replay, and crash recovery.
does_not_own: accelerate campaign orchestration, workers, IVP, VerificationReceiptCache
ZK proof systems or seal authority

methods.contract: CID-verified local read; backend load may repair local tree after integrity check.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(self, cid: str) -> Dict[str, Any]
methods.contract: Returns canonical JSON object only when bytes equal re-serialized canonical form.

methods.name: has
methods.signature: has(self, cid: str, *, include_backend: bool = False) -> bool

methods.name: current_state_root
methods.signature: current_state_root(self, namespace: str) -> Dict[str, Any]
methods.contract: Absent namespaces begin at revision 0 with null root_cid and transition_cid. Live reads verify the full indexed transition chain against immutable blocks.

methods.name: compare_and_swap_state_root
methods.signature: compare_and_swap_state_root(self, namespace: str, *, expected_revision: int, expected_root_cid: Optional[str], new_root_cid: str, operation_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]
methods.contract: One-writer expected-revision CAS under BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Transition block is immutable evidence; root index mutates only in the same full-synchronous transaction that indexes that block. operation_id is a durable idempotency key per namespace.

methods.name: state_roots
methods.signature: state_roots(self) -> list[Dict[str, Any]]

methods.name: root_transitions
methods.signature: root_transitions(self, namespace: Optional[str] = None) -> list[Dict[str, Any]]
methods.contract: Append-only transition history reconstructed from immutable evidence; basis for campaign-history patterns.

methods.name: recover
methods.signature: recover(self, *, rebuild: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]
methods.contract: Verifies every local block against its CID. Corrupt blocks fail closed. rebuild=True recreates all derived indexes from verified immutable blocks including root chains and Profile G claim/lease/health indexes. rebuild=False is a verify-only pass used on healthy reopen.

methods.name: root_recovery_metrics
methods.signature: root_recovery_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, int]
methods.contract: Session-local structural counters, not persisted coordination state and not wall-clock timings.

methods.name: compact_indexes
methods.signature: compact_indexes(self, *, at_ms: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]
methods.contract: Archives and prunes stale claim/lease/health index rows only. Artifact blocks are permanently retained.

methods: compare_and_swap_root(namespace, *, expected_revision, expected_root_cid, new_root_cid, operation_id) -> StateRootCASResult
DurableStateRoots.contract: Storage-facing protocol only. Implementations own I/O and publication. Protocol module owns neither store opening nor CID derivation.

methods.name: put_verified
methods.contract: Requires caller-supplied expected_cid; validates dag-json semantic CID before local put; projects optional replication into closed ProviderStatus without obscuring local durability.

methods.name: get_verified
methods.contract: CID-verified get through the injected store after semantic dag-json CID validation.

methods.name: current_root
methods.contract: Projects store snapshot to typed StateRootSnapshot and revalidates CID-bearing fields.

methods.name: compare_and_swap_root
methods.contract: Semantic-facade CAS: rejects raw CIDs for expected and successor roots; delegates to store.compare_and_swap_state_root; returns typed StateRootCASResult.

methods.name: recover_roots
methods.contract: Calls store.recover(rebuild=True) and projects roots; raw or corrupt reconstructed roots become closed corrupt recovery reports rather than leaking exceptions.

DurableStateRootAdapter.identity_boundary: ipfs_datasets_py owns semantic identity. Callers compute CID; adapter and store only verify. Adapter does not canonicalize, translate, or mint replacement identity.

SemanticGovernorStore.role_for_aae: Reusable thin-typed durability pattern (artifacts, history, policy/promotion CAS, receipt issuance shape, recovery report shape). AAE must mirror the pattern under adversarial_assurance_store with AAE namespaces and datasets assurance schemas — not fork a second block engine.

DurablePromotionStateRepository.authorization_rule: Promotion CAS requires distinct candidate_cid and authorization_cid; candidates cannot self-promote.

protocol_only_surfaces.recover_governor_store: Contracted returning AuditRecoveryReport; no recovery.py implementer is present on this pin (SCG-022 style recovery remains unshipped). AAE must recover through DurableCoordinationStore.recover / DurableStateRootAdapter.recover_roots until AAE-038 ships AssuranceRecoveryReport.

Never starts a daemon or discovers ~/.ipfs

Oversized, mismatched, symlink, and path-escape cases are typed misses/rejections

immutable_blocks.authority: Local blocks/ tree is authoritative; SQLite is a rebuildable acceleration index.
write_path: canonical JSON serialization (sort_keys, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
CID computation from bytes and codec
atomic temp write + fsync + link into shard directory
optional backend store_block after local durability
immutable_blocks.collision_policy: Identical bytes are idempotent (created=false). Different bytes for the same CID raise ArtifactIntegrityError.
immutable_blocks.retention: Artifact blocks are permanent. RetentionPolicy and compact_indexes affect derived index rows only; they emit mcp++/coordination-index-archive@1 before pruning rows.

invariants: successor root block must exist before CAS publication and during reconstruction

namespace.aae_namespace_note: AAE campaign/policy/promotion/history namespaces are not frozen by kit storage. AAE-034+ must define closed adversarial-assurance namespaces over the same segment grammar and must not overload semantic-governor/* without an explicit ownership decision.

operation_id.scope_governor_artifacts: operation_id uniqueness in governor_artifact_ops.sqlite3 bind table

rejected_forms: non-zero revision/generation with null root/head CID
expected_version_cas.serialization: BEGIN IMMEDIATE under store RLock; one winner among concurrent writers
expected_version_cas.interruption_recovery_rule: Reopen recovers to the prior root or the sole durable successor reconstructed from immutable transition blocks; never invents promotion or completion.

promotion_extra_fields.candidate_cid: required distinct content CID for promotion candidate
promotion_extra_fields.authorization_cid: required distinct authorization evidence CID; self-promotion forbidden

expected_version_cas.history_append_mapping: DurableAuditHistoryStore.append_history maps generation/head CAS onto compare_and_swap_state_root; successor root is a deterministic history-manifest CID referencing entry_cid and prior head.

StateRootSnapshot.revision_zero: root_cid and transition_cid must be null

ReceiptIssuanceResult.envelope_rule: envelope_schema must name an existing envelope; semantic-governor/receipt* prefixes are rejected

corruption.backend_cid_mismatch: ArtifactIntegrityError on get; adapter put_verified projects ProviderStatus.CORRUPT without claiming replication success
corruption.corrupt_sqlite: Preserved as coordination.sqlite3.corrupt-<ms> and rebuilt from immutable blocks
corruption.tampered_root_index: current_state_root / CAS verify chain against blocks and refuse mutation
corruption.ambiguous_successors: Reconstruction rejects without picking a winner
corruption.semantic_facade_raw_root: validate_semantic_dag_json_cid rejects raw transport CIDs; generic store may still hold raw coordination artifacts

concurrency.cross_process_cas: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes writers before expectation is observed as current
concurrency.outcome: Exactly one distinct winner; losers receive typed conflict

startup: If SQLite unreadable: preserve corrupt file, recreate empty index
If local blocks exist: recover(rebuild=False) verify pass
If artifacts index empty or root indexes disagree with immutable chain: recover(rebuild=True)
fail_closed_conditions: Missing successor root for a transition
recovery.adapter_projection: recover_roots returns StateRootRecoveryReport; semantic validation failures become errors=[{code: corrupt, message: ...}] with empty reconstructed_roots
recovery.governor_domain_recovery: AuditRecoveryReport is contracted but recover_governor_store is not implemented on this pin; AAE-038 must compose store.recover and project AAE heads similarly

append_preconditions: entry_cid must already be durable dag-json
governor_campaign_history_pattern.privacy: public projections expose portable CIDs/generations only; reject absolute/local paths and private field markers

history.aae_reuse: AAE campaign histories must use the same CAS-linked append-only manifest pattern over DurableCoordinationStore; do not treat Profile G claim/lease indexes as campaign history.

governor_issue_receipt_contract.forbids_new_hierarchy: envelope_schema must not start with semantic-governor/receipt

agent_supervisor_resolver.property: no synthetic success; missing or corrupt blocks are denied/unavailable

receipts.aae_reuse: Campaign execution receipts and promotion receipts bind datasets-neutral payloads into existing envelope schemas, store immutable blocks via put/put_artifact, and resolve only through verified CAS reads.

certificate_transport.authority_limit: Exact-byte move by CID only; not proof of reuse, not seal authority, not ZK

proof_store.status: typed_unavailable for sealer; available for certificate transport only

root_recovery_metrics.root_index_rebuild_mutations: Incremented only for committed root-index DELETE/INSERT work

metrics.healthy_reopen_property: When indexes already match immutable transitions, reopen verification leaves root_index_rebuild_mutations at zero.
metrics.note: No AAE campaign metrics exist in kit yet; those belong to adversarial_assurance_store and accelerate benchmark tasks.

optional_backend.import_side_effects: Package import and adapter construction perform no provider discovery, installation, network service, or daemon startup.

covers: backend repair of missing local block
expected CID and recovery fail-closed corruption
raw CID rejection at semantic facade
healthy reopen without root-index rebuild mutations
protocol shape including issue_receipt and recover_governor_store
entry integrity and unavailable entry outcomes

tests.inventory_note: Counts are static def test_* enumerations on this pin, not a green pytest run. Inventory does not restate a green suite as AAE campaign readiness.

profile_g_artifacts.purpose: Hermetic coordination/receipt seal tests without requiring an external MCP++ checkout.

do: Compose DurableCoordinationStore for all durable AAE artifacts
Use DurableStateRootAdapter when publishing semantic dag-json campaign/policy/promotion roots
Mirror semantic_governor_store thin-typed patterns under adversarial_assurance_store
Require caller-supplied verified CIDs and operation_ids
Treat CAS conflict/unchanged/corrupt/unavailable as closed outcomes
Recover only from verified immutable blocks via recover / recover_roots
Bind receipts to existing envelope schemas; resolve only through verified block reads
Use IpfsKitProofCertificateStore only as optional certificate byte transport
do_not: Open a second block store or WAL
Trust a supplied CID without recomputing or verifying canonical bytes
Delete history to roll back; use another authorized CAS to a prior CID
Treat Profile G claim/lease indexes as campaign history
Invent IncrementalProofSealer or seal APIs while typed_unavailable
Create a new receipt envelope hierarchy or cryptography
Infer adversarial_assurance_store APIs from documentation alone before AAE-034+
